chapter: Paul Barbarin and his own bands
title: Leading his own band in the mid-1950s
summary: He names the players he used when he first led a band around 1954-55, including Clement Tervalon, Wallace Davenport and Harold Dejan.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I never got to hear it. When did you first lead your own band?
Oh, that wasn't too long ago. It must have been around... 54, 55 I had a Dixon Lane outfit.
Clemens Tervalon, Wallace Davenport, Saeed. What's Saeed right now? Frazier. Frazier on drums. Oh, a couple of times I had Emma Barry on piano with me.
Oh, Clarin' that was hard to keep up with. I mean, having a regular band. I had one time, this fellow that died after a kid, Ernest.
Ernest Moya, yeah. He worked with me. Wow. Howard Dejan work with me several times.
On what instrument was he on?
Saxophone. And Mr. Fatty, Louie Contrell, he played a couple times with me. That's our president, local president. You know.
Ever used Kit Howard or Paul Barnes?
Yeah, the kid played a couple times with me too. He played a couple of jobs I had, Jackson Barracks and a couple other spots I, you know, booked them on.
